evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
For enrollment, the following fees apply: €1,500 international tuition fee and €180 semester fee (for the Winter Semester 2026/27).

The document recognizing your academic qualifications is a mandatory part of your application. To do so, you must apply to Uni Assist for a preliminary review documentation (Vorprüfungsdokumentation - VPD which assesses your eligibility for university admission in Germany).

notes: The DAAD page states the application period as 15 June - 30 November, which corresponds to the application deadline of 30 November, not 3 December as stated on the programme page; however, the 3 December deadline is on the programme's own page and is for the summer term 2027. Tuition is quoted per semester (€1,500 per semester = €3,000 per year) for non-EU applicants; a semester contribution of €170–€180 also applies. The teaching language is English; German language modules are included but not a requirement for admission (no minimum level required). The application channel for foreign-diploma applicants is uni-assist VPD, as required for recognition of academic qualifications.

note.fr: Un test d'aptitude (TestAS ou SAT/ACT) est normalement requis pour les programmes de Bachelor. Vérifiez les exigences exactes pour les candidats internationaux.
note.en: An aptitude test (TestAS or SAT/ACT) is normally required for Bachelor's programmes. Please check the exact requirements for international applicants.
